fix(anthropic): keep carrier cache opt-out under max-lines
fix(anthropic): stay under max-lines after carrier opt-out restore
fix(anthropic): drop one line to satisfy max-lines
fix(anthropic): opt out only relocated runtime-context carriers
fix(anthropic): align carrier cache anchors with replay lifecycle
fix(anthropic): preserve transient context cache reuse
fix(ci): register the live Anthropic cache entry point
